name: Browse products and save an order
description: Verifies the public catalogue loads and checkout saves an order using a server-calculated total.
steps: Browse the shop and add a product to the bag
Complete valid customer and delivery details
Submit the order
Sign in to the store dashboard and inspect the order
expected: The order is saved and appears in the store dashboard with the correct NGN total.

name: Store-owned password login replaces AppDeploy sign-in
description: Verifies the store dashboard uses its own password and rejects incorrect passwords.
steps: Open Store admin from the footer
Enter an incorrect password
Enter the configured store password of at least 12 characters
Open the Products and Orders tabs
expected: Incorrect credentials are rejected, and only the configured store password opens management features.

name: Upload product photos and publish them in the catalogue
covers: image displayed in the public catalogue
description: Verifies an administrator can upload an actual product photo, preview it, save the product, and see it on the shop page.
steps: Sign in to Store admin and open Products
Choose Add a product or Edit for an existing item
Upload a JPG, PNG or WebP product photo under 5 MB
Save the product and refresh the shop
expected: The photo is stored, the product editor shows a preview, and the product photo is visible in the public catalogue after refresh.

name: Edit product details and inventory
covers: preserve uploaded image path while editing
description: Verifies the store owner can update existing product names, categories, descriptions, prices, images and stock.
steps: Sign in to Store admin
Open Products and choose Edit for an existing product
Change the price, description or stock and save
Refresh the dashboard and public catalogue
expected: The saved product changes remain visible in the dashboard and public catalogue.

name: WhatsApp-only checkout and order confirmation
covers: visible order summary with item quantities and subtotal
order details included in WhatsApp message
fallback to WhatsApp if order API fails
description: Verifies checkout always hands the customer to WhatsApp and still provides the order details if saving the order fails.
steps: Submit an order with a valid email
Submit checkout with valid customer and delivery details
Confirm WhatsApp opens with the order details
Simulate an order API failure and confirm WhatsApp fallback still opens
expected: WhatsApp is the only checkout destination, including when the order API is temporarily unavailable.

name: Update fulfilment status and validate checkout
covers: mobile-friendly checkout summary and sign-in layout
visible product edit and delete controls
description: Verifies invalid checkout details are rejected and an administrator can update an order's fulfilment status.
steps: On mobile, submit checkout with a required field empty
Complete the customer details and save a valid order
In Store admin, set the order to Processing
Refresh the order list
expected: Incomplete checkout is rejected, while a valid order and its updated Processing status remain saved.
